name: dsh-mcp-mgr-workspace
description: Workspace root for the two dsh-mcp-mgr packages: the host manager and the sidebar panel

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr typecheck && pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr-ui typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr build && pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr-ui build
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr verify && pnpm --filter dsh-mcp-mgr-ui verify
scripts.//check: build BOTH packages before verifying either: the host's verifier reads the UI package's built bundle.
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm verify
